title: VDBE numeric, null, pointer, value, and zero-blob bindings

scope.rationale: These seven binding operations form the source-layout typed-value layer above vdbeUnbind: they atomically install scalar, pointer, copied Mem, and zero-filled blob representations while preserving destructor, mutex, range, expiration, and API-exit behavior.
excluded_responsibilities: Text/blob wrapper entry points already covered by the adjacent bindText unit
Public bounded Statement ownership and exported ABI dispatch
Statement step, reset, and finalize lifecycle

external_source_responsibilities: Source-equivalent Mem scalar, pointer, zero-blob, and transient string setters
dependencies.caller_closure: The complete seven selected source bodies are assigned. The trivial sqlite3_bind_int forwarding wrapper and public ABI owner switch remain outside this unit.

inputs: Nullable source-layout Vdbe, one-based variable index, scalar/pointer/Mem value, destructor metadata, or zero-blob length
outputs: MISUSE, RANGE, TOOBIG, NOMEM, or OK with one source Mem variable atomically replaced
contracts.ownership: Unbind releases the previous value. Pointer ownership transfers on success and its destructor runs on rejection or later replacement. bindValue transiently copies text/blob input. Zero blobs retain only logical length.
contracts.state_and_results: READY/range checks and expmask expiration come from vdbeUnbind. Scalar setters preserve source storage flags. The 64-bit zero-blob wrapper keeps the old binding when the length exceeds SQLITE_LIMIT_LENGTH and normalizes through sqlite3ApiExit.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: The connection recursive mutex remains held from successful unbind through replacement. Pointer destructors may execute on failed or later replacement. No I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Busy/range/too-big paths preserve the old value where source does. Successful replacement, destructor release, and subsequent rebinding remain valid.

representation_differences: The existing typed StringOwnership and pointer-destructor function types replace C destructor sentinels.
Each one-based signed index is wrapped and bitcast to the source unsigned zero-based index so invalid values take the RANGE path without a Zig cast trap.
The source Mem union is retained exactly; the differential normalizes only pointer addresses and compares scalar union payload bits.

oracle.protocol: The shared VDBE builder worker binds double, signed integer, NULL, destructor-owned pointer, direct zero blob, Mem zero blob, and over-limit 64-bit zero blob values through pinned C and Zig source-layout owners. It compares exact results, Mem flags/encoding/length/subtype/destructor presence, destructor count, and scalar payload bits.
internal_observations: result code and exact Mem storage flags
double bit pattern, signed integer bits, and zero-blob logical length
pointer subtype/destructor installation and exactly-once replacement destruction
wide-length TOOBIG preservation of the existing variable
oracle.normalization: Pointer addresses are not emitted; all result, flag, encoding, length, subtype, destructor, and payload observations are exact.

assurance.oom: Transient-copy OOM remains covered by the adjacent bindText unit; these selected scalar/pointer/zero setters allocate no replacement payload.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O. Recursive connection-mutex handoff is shared with the exact vdbeUnbind dependency.
assurance.malformed_input: Busy and RANGE validation is inherited from vdbeUnbind; the differential covers a negative value widened to the over-limit u64 zero-blob boundary.
assurance.continuation: Pointer replacement runs its destructor once; over-limit zero-blob preserves the old value; later operations continue.
assurance.performance: Constant-time variable lookup and storage-class dispatch; zero blobs do not materialize their logical payload.

integration.native_call_path: The source-layout worker calls all seven operations against exact Vdbe/aVar/Sqlite3 owners. Exported sqlite3_bind_* APIs still dispatch through the bounded Statement owner.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Switch public prepared statements and exported typed bind APIs to source-layout Vdbe before integration credit.

independent_review.notes: Requires public statement integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Port or remap the trivial text/blob/int wrappers as part of the public ABI owner switch.
Switch public prepared-statement ownership and step/reset/finalize to source-layout Vdbe.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/vdbeapi.c:1748-1931 was reviewed completely for all adjacent typed binding bodies, assertions, mutex handoff, destructor failure handling, storage-class switch, zero-blob limit, and API-exit behavior
src/core/internal/vdbe_api.zig and vdbe_mem.zig scalar/pointer/string/zero-blob setters were reviewed with exact Vdbe/Sqlite3/Mem fields
callers: Public sqlite3_bind_double/int64/null/pointer/value/zeroblob/zeroblob64 entry points are direct API callers
sqlite3_bind_int forwards to int64; text/blob wrappers remain in the adjacent bindText source unit
Prepared execution, reset, clear, and finalize consume the installed aVar values
callees: vdbeUnbind validates READY/index, enters and deliberately retains the connection mutex, releases the old value, and applies expiration
Mem scalar, pointer, zero-blob, and transient string operations preserve source ownership and storage flags
sqlite3ApiExit masks or normalizes the wide zero-blob result before the outer recursive mutex leave
assertions_branches_cleanup: All 34 active behavior IDs cover successful unbind assertions, pointer rejection cleanup, the full five-storage-class value switch, and the wide-length guard
Each successful unbind has exactly one corresponding mutex leave after replacement
Pointer ownership transfers exactly once and zero-blob payloads remain logical rather than allocated
upstream_tests: Upstream bind, bindxfer, pointer, zeroblob, value, misuse, limit, destructor, reset, and finalize suites exercise these APIs
Project VDBE builder differential compares seven typed-binding transitions in a 392-observation source-layout trace; Mem differential covers delegated setters
